subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Diverge
solution:
The correct answer is: **Converge**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Diverge** means to separate from another route and going in a different direction.

 
 
• **Example - ***They were close friends in college, but after graduation, their lives **diverged**.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Converge** means to move toward the same point and come closer together or meet.
 
 
• **Example -** *The two roads **converge** in the center of town.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Diverge'** and '**Converge'** are **opposite in meaning**.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Depart **means to leave, especially in order to start a journey.
 
• **Contrast **means an obvious difference between two or more things.
 
• **Submerge** means moving or sloping downwards.
